title: Scenario-driven RICE-Delta playbook for token-cost & latency regimes
creator: Aisha Roberts
description: Goal: Provide a reusable, scenario-driven prioritization playbook that augments RICE scoring with token-cost elasticity and latency-SLO regime penalties. This ticket produces: 1) a written playbook that product managers can apply to candidate initiatives, 2) a calculator (spreadsheet + small script) that computes the RICE-Delta score, and 3) a sample scoring pass across active roadmap candidates so leadership can validate the results. The playbook is designed for Redwood Inference-specific signals: per-route token economics, latency percentile buckets (p50/p95/p99), and Dedicated vs Hosted deployment cost differentials.
decision_rationale: Standard RICE fails to reflect material operational costs and latency risk for inference products. We need a lightweight extension that remains explainable but adds two production signals: a token-cost multiplier (captures per-token cost + batching/caching effects) and a latency-regime penalty (captures SLA/SLO risk and required fallbacks). RICE-Delta preserves the original RICE ordering in benign cases but surfaces high-cost/latency-risk items that otherwise hide behind impact estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published under Roadmap Prioritization space with step-by-step calculator instructions
A working Google Sheet + exported CSV calculator that accepts: reach, impact, confidence, effort, avg token cost, token elasticity factor, latency bucket distribution
A sample scoring pass applied to 12 live initiatives with documented rationale for adjustments
Console dashboard query (saved) that returns per-route token cost and p95 latency for SLO-aligned cohorts
Leadership review completed and sign-off recorded in meeting notes
implementation_steps: Define token-cost multiplier: base_cost = normalized cost_per_1000_tokens for workload; multiplier = 1 + (base_cost - baseline)/baseline * elasticity_coefficient
Define latency-regime penalty: penalty = 1 + max(0, (p95_latency_ms - latency_target_ms)/latency_target_ms) * latency_sensitivity
Compute RICE-Delta: raw_rice = Reach * Impact * Confidence / Effort; adjusted_score = raw_rice / (token_cost_multiplier * latency_penalty)
Create calculator: Google Sheet with named inputs and sample rows; include example calculations and edge-case guidance
Integrate signals: link sheet inputs to Console saved queries and attach sample exports
Run scoring pass: apply to current roadmap candidates and generate a prioritized list and variance notes
Publish playbook and schedule leadership review
tradeoffs: Extra complexity vs explainability: we add two modifiers that increase fidelity but require data plumbing
Potential bias toward low-cost features: cost modifiers can deprioritize high-impact features that are expensive but strategically important; mitigation is manual override with documented rationale
Data freshness vs cadence: accurate token-cost and latency signals require recent telemetry; too-frequent recalculation may cause noise

notes: Guidance: Use RICE-Delta for cross-functional prioritization where operational cost or latency risk materially affects business outcomes (e.g., high-volume embeddings routes, low-latency chat endpoints). For early-stage feature discovery or experiments, prefer raw RICE to avoid overfitting to noisy cost signals.
